m10.original_defect: SqliteStore.__init__ itself invoked migration, so ordinary store construction could mutate state before compatibility was established, treat opening as migration admission, silently upgrade older state, misclassify an existing DB without schema_migrations as fresh, and let a v6+ DB proceed under v5 software because no migrations remained to run; rollback/version-skew behavior was unguarded.
